affected_callers: GitHub Actions Verify Adam Development Habits workflow

acceptance_criteria.condition: The workflow installs the explicitly pinned pytest test dependency before running the suite.
The isolation audit rejects a command that only prints a Skill path instead of completing an exact full cat read.
The QuixBugs replay remains exercised rather than skipped when the CI runner is clean.
README explains that pytest is CI-only and not a Skill runtime dependency.

invariants: The CI workflow verifies the full Skill package instead of skipping external replay tests when dependencies are absent.
A frozen Skill snapshot is proven only by a completed exact cat command whose output equals the complete snapshot bytes.
pytest is pinned and used only for the QuixBugs test replay; the installed Skill has no runtime dependency.

documentation_synchronization.evidence: The captured verification artifact records the dependency resolver, tests, YAML parse, and diff check.

safeguards.name: declared CI-only test dependency
safeguards.rationale: requirements-ci.txt pins pytest==8.4.2 so a clean GitHub runner can execute the existing QuixBugs replay.

safeguards.name: portable negative fixture
safeguards.rationale: The fixture now prints a path rather than issuing cat, so it cannot be accidentally accepted on platforms without macOS path aliases.

safeguards.name: quality gate retained
safeguards.rationale: The workflow still executes all tests and evidence checks; no failure is suppressed or skipped.

design_boundary.rationale: The workflow owns CI environment preparation, requirements-ci.txt owns the test-only dependency version, and the fixture owns negative audit input construction.

dependency_audit.rationale: pytest==8.4.2 is the minimum explicit test runner required by the existing QuixBugs replay; it is pinned, has no production runtime consumer, and is removable with that replay.

extension_decision.rationale: The repair extends existing workflow and test owners without introducing an extension point or adapter.

data_ownership.rationale: Only deterministic test fixtures, CI configuration, and documentation change; no mutable business or personal data is handled.

error_model.rationale: A missing test runner now fails during an explicit dependency-installation step, while the portable fixture rejects a path claim that lacks full-read evidence.

contract_evolution.rationale: The audit contract remains exact-cat-plus-full-output; only its negative test input is corrected to express the intended invalid condition on every platform.

operational_budget.rationale: The test dependency installation has no application runtime budget or production performance impact.

threat_boundary.rationale: The change does not process secrets, untrusted production input, or privileged application operations.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The dependency declaration, workflow step, portable regression fixture, README update, evidence, and checks are delivered as one atomic CI repair.

release_recovery.rationale: No deployable service or release rollout changes; the complete repair can be reverted in one commit.

data_migration.rationale: No schema, backfill, persistence format, or production data changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: The CI configuration receives only a committed requirements path; it introduces no credential, environment secret, or user-controlled input.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: pytest is a pinned CI-only dependency with an explicit removal condition: remove requirements-ci.txt and the install step if the QuixBugs replay no longer uses pytest.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README identifies pytest as a CI-only replay dependency and the evidence records why the workflow installs it.

reproducibility.rationale: The pinned requirements file, exact verification commands, timestamp, revision, and captured outputs allow local and GitHub replay.

verification.result: The resolver selected the pinned pytest==8.4.2 test-only dependency without modifying the local environment.
8 portability and QuixBugs replay tests passed.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Dependency resolution selected the pinned CI-only pytest release.
The portable negative fixture and the existing QuixBugs public/hidden replay passed.
The workflow containing the dependency-installation step is valid YAML.
The CI portability repair had no whitespace errors.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert this atomic commit to restore the prior workflow and test fixture; do not remove the replay tests merely because a clean runner lacks their declared dependency.
remaining_risks: The pinned pytest wheel is resolved from PyPI during CI; GitHub Actions remains the authoritative clean Python 3.14 verification.
The existing Actions Node 20 deprecation notice is unrelated to this failure and does not change the workflow result.
